purpose: Teach: 降ら/好ま/つる/吐き/墨/艶/差し出し/お過ごし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、雪、降らないな、暖冬かな。
lines.en: We haven't had snow in a while. Maybe it'll be a mild winter this year.
lines.style: Gentle, observational opening. Quiet conversational tone. Slight pause between the thought and the question, like he's musing aloud rather than expecting an answer. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あなた、夏は好まない料理、多いわね。
lines.en: You're right. And there are quite a few summer dishes you don't care for.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, as if continuing a familiar thread. Tender, matter-of-fact tone. Not pushing the point but noting it with the ease of long knowing. Soft trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭のキウイ、つる、年々増える。
lines.en: The kiwi vines in the garden keep spreading more each year.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. A touch of wonder at the passage of time. Slow, deliberate pace. Watching the vines grow as a gentle marker of the seasons passing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 体調悪い日、無理に吐きそうな時、寝ていてね。
lines.en: On the days you're not feeling well — when you're close to being sick — just rest. Don't push yourself.
lines.style: Gentle insistence wrapped in care. Quiet firmness underneath the softness, like a quiet instruction that comes from real concern. Even pacing, no rush. Finishes with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、習字で、墨、よく使ったな。
lines.en: Back when I was young, I used so much ink doing calligraphy.
lines.style: Nostalgic, looking back into memory. Soft reverence for the effort it took. Slow and reflective pace. A small smile in the voice, remembering the young man's hands stained with ink.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お肌、年取っても艶、残ってるわよ、あなた。
lines.en: Your skin has held its glow beautifully, even now. You've aged so well.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, not flattery. Warm but spare — he's not one to say more than needed. Direct gaze in the voice. Simple, sincere delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫に、おやつ、差し出してくれる、お前、優しいな。
lines.en: You're kind, offering snacks to the grandchildren like that.
lines.style: Tender recognition of something he's noticed and loved about her. Quiet warmth. No grand statement — just seeing her and saying it simply. Soft, steady pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 近況、年賀状で、いかがお過ごしか、書きましょう。
lines.en: Let's write something in the New Year's cards about how we've been doing. 'How are you keeping?' — something like that.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, practical and close. Warm finality, like he's settling into the ritual of the season together. Unhurried, intimate in its ordinariness. Quiet contentment at the end.
